name: What should I do first before tile wall installation?

mainEntity.name: What should I do first before tile wall installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start by checking whether the wall is flat, dry, and structurally sound. For tile wall installation, the biggest issues are hidden moisture, loose drywall, and uneven surfaces, so a good installer will inspect the area before giving a final plan. In the Denver metro area, that first step also helps confirm whether you need prep work, waterproofing, or tile removal before new tile goes up.
acceptedAnswer.description: Check that the wall is flat, dry, and solid before tile goes on. Any damage, moisture, or uneven spots should be fixed first so the tile bonds properly and lasts.
